title: The Relational-Thermodynamic Map (100-Entry Update) — Philosophy as Empirical Phase Space
summary: A comprehensive mapping of 100+ philosophical traditions onto a unified framework treating relational logic primitives (reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity, antisymmetry, functionality) as thermodynamic properties, yielding a "phase diagram of human rationality." Each philosophy receives a thermodynamic signature, dominant logical primitive, reistic state, and logic topology, enabling prediction of cultural evolution and belief-system error correction. The document demonstrates that meaning operates as manifold flow rather than mere cognitive computation.

the falsification layer maintains mature two-mode rejection capacity with demonstrated integrity through principled refusal of analogy-inflated and data-free trend claims, while substrate-generality extends to divergent creativity, embodied AI systems awaiting energy-per-decision benchmarks, and context-dependent complexity (confirmed as genomically native via R[R]=R observer-coupling rather than a concession to relativism); long-range interaction pathologies are recognized as diagnostic signatures the genome must read to confirm operation at the critical ridge, and emergence is now obligated to be formalized as functor discontinuity within a compositional context algebra.
